summary: A clip refers to a project item the project no longer has.
A clip uses media made offline, so it renders the offline slate.
A clip uses media whose file the host cannot lend (missing, or outside the workspace), so it renders the offline slate.
A clip reads past the end of its media, so those frames hold the last one.
A sequence has no clips: it renders black, silent frames.
The first video track has black between two clips; the fix closes the gap.
A clip is disabled, so it neither shows nor plays; the fix enables it.
A title or caption track uses a font family that is not available, so it draws in the default family.
A code was found more than 100 times; the rest are counted, not listed.
